resourceProfile.assessment: Canonical English, the complete Nynorsk source scope, glossary, review metadata, UI context, and the locale normalization layer were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review generation, queue and findings validation, TypeScript type checking, 12 focused tests, the production IIS build, route-contract validation, and generated internal-link validation passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A fresh bounded Nynorsk critique found residual Bokmål in battery-safety help and source-backed battery evidence.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Nynorsk human review was performed; corrected entries remain machine reviewed.

publicationAuthorization.summary: The owner requested correction commits, not publication or deployment.

findings.summary: The battery-safety help remained predominantly Bokmål rather than Nynorsk.
evidence: The locale is independent Nynorsk and its glossary and surrounding UI use Nynorsk forms.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the complete help text in idiomatic Nynorsk while preserving its safety meaning.

findings.summary: The pooled battery evidence dictionary contained repeated Bokmål morphology and vocabulary across nineteen safety-relevant notes.
evidence: The affected shared dictionary fans out to the corresponding battery catalog entries.
findings.resolution: Converted the affected evidence notes to Nynorsk and retained every rating, protected unit, model identifier, and qualification.
